Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can delete a Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I also use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to delete my Digimon?
Can I use this card's inherited effect to switch the target of attack to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 level 5 or lower Digimon.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Cyborg] or [Composite] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -1: 5 Lv.5 or lower [Cyborg]/[Composite] trait Digimon cards w/different card numbers
